theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Matching Investment Timeline to Life Goals
body: Different goals need different time horizons. Align your investment approach with when you'll need the funds.
caption: Education goals might span 15-20 years, while a wedding fund could be 3-5 years away. Your investment strategy should reflect these timelines. #GoalBasedInvesting #TimeHorizon #WealthBuilding #LifeGoals #InvestmentStrategy
